info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程提供機械與電腦輔助工程科系學生雷射工程之基本知識。課程先介紹雷射工作原理，並延伸至雷射系統的型態、光學元件的探討。本課程提供雷射工程應用之基礎。
description.describe_eh: This curse provides the mechanical engineering students with background information on lasers, beginning with the fundamentals of how a laser works and extending through the common laser types, optics and major components of laser system. The course gives guidelines for common laser applications.
description.pre_subname: MATH1001微積分(一)、MATH1002微積分(二)、PHYS1003普通物理(一)、PHYS1004普通物理(二)
description.pre_sub_ename: MATH1001 CALCULUS(1)、MATH1002 CALCULUS(2)、PHYS1003 GENERAL PHYSICS(1)、PHYS1004 GENERAL PHYSICS(2)
